create_image.summary: Create a new image from a description, or modify an image.
create_image.guidance: Use only when the user asks for an image to be produced or changed; writing or improving a prompt alone does not mean generating. The image model only sees the images passed in source and reference: an image that is only described in the prompt is not used.
create_image.prompt: Complete description of the image to produce (subject, composition, style, lighting).

source.description: Image to modify. Omit to create a new image.

reference.description: Images whose subject, character or style must be reused.

create_video.summary: Create a video clip from a description, optionally starting or ending on given images or keeping a subject from reference images.
create_video.guidance: Propose a video only when the user asks for one. Every video is shown to the user, who can edit it before it runs. The video model only sees the images passed in start_image, end_image and reference: an image that is only described in the prompt is not used. When the request involves several images, pass every one of them, each in the role that fits. Before generating, agree on the video with the user in a short message (a few lines, no tool): how you understand the clip, the length in seconds, what each image is used for, and only the questions still open; call this tool once they answered.
create_video.prompt: Complete description of the clip: action, camera movement, style and, if wanted, sound. Naming an image here does not show it to the video model.

start_image.description: Image the video starts on, as its first frame: the choice to animate an image or to make a video from it.

end_image.description: Image the video ends on, as its last frame: where the camera or the action arrives. Can be combined with start_image.

reference.description: Images of a person, a character, an object or a place that must appear in the clip, kept as they look. They are not frames of the clip: to animate an image, use start_image.

extend_video.summary: Continue an existing video with a new shot that follows its last frames.
extend_video.guidance: Every video is shown to the user, who can edit it before it runs. Before generating, agree with the user in a short message (no tool) on what happens next and for how many seconds; call this tool once they answered.
extend_video.prompt: What happens next in the continuation.

create_audio.summary: Create music, an ambience or sound effects from a description.
create_audio.guidance: Use only when the user asks for sound or music to be produced.
create_audio.prompt: Description of the sound or music: genre, instruments, mood, tempo, duration.

upscale.summary: Increase the resolution and sharpness of an existing image or video.
upscale.guidance: Use when the user wants a larger or sharper version of an existing result.

interpolate.summary: Make an existing video smoother by adding intermediate frames.
interpolate.guidance: Use when the user wants a smoother or slow-motion version of an existing video.
